notes: Street ID comes from the corrected map and stays the source of truth.
Endpoint 1 is always the first point of the stored corrected path.
Endpoint 2 is always the last point of the stored corrected path.
The final player should keep one active video element and swap run assets on demand.
Do not preload every run video at once.
Street folders group the two run directions for the same street together.
The manifest exposes both nested streets[] and flattened runs[] for easier site logic.
Grid-analysis outputs live inside each canonical run folder under grid-analysis/.
